metadata.description: Piping engineering skills from PipingToolset for Claude, ChatGPT, Codex and any Agent Skills host.

plugins.name: piping-toolset
plugins.description: Six ASME B31.1 / B31.3 piping skills by pipingtoolset.com: pipe stress check (SUS/OCC/EXP hand checks, cold-eye review), stress import (PDF isos, Revit PCF, Navisworks supports into CAESAR II or AutoPIPE), load cases, pipe supports (AISC 360-22, ACI 318-25/19, ASCE 7-22), nozzle loads (API 610/617/660/661/560/650, NEMA SM-23, PVP2011-57100), bolted flanges (BPVC VIII-2 4.16). No ASME/API/PIP tables embedded; an optional connector serves cited ASME and API table values to signed-in paid accounts.
